title: Redeem your York 1Password student licence
issue: You need to activate your student 1Password account
resolution_html:
1. Sign in to York MySoftware using Passport York
  2. Open Personal, then Software Order Form and select the 1Password student licence for your program
  3. Request one licence code and complete the no-payment order confirmation
  4. Open the resulting licence email and follow the redemption instructions
  5. Redeem the code at 1Password’s redemption page using your York student email address and follow the verification email

See the York student setup guide for current ordering details
